shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g '*config*' -g 'README*' -g 'public/**' -g 'components/**' -g '*css' -g '*tsx' -g '*jsx' -g '*ts' -g '*js'"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && find .. -name AGENTS.md -print'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html && ls node_modules/@playwright 2>/dev/null; npm ls --depth=0'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const p of ['playwright','@playwright/test','puppeteer']) {try { console.log(p, import.meta.resolve(p)); } catch { console.log(p, 'not installed'); }}\" && ls /usr/bin/chrom* /opt/google/chrome/chrome /root/.cache/ms-playwright /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; git diff --stat"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --prefix /tmp/orbit-browser playwright'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'
/bin/bash -lc '/tmp/orbit-browser/node_modules/.bin/playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx --yes --package prettier prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css src/main.tsx index.html'

/bin/bash -lc 'sed -i "s/chromium.launch({headless:true,/chromium.launch({headless:true,executablePath:chromium.executablePath(),/" /tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs
node /tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc '/tmp/orbit-browser/node_modules/.bin/playwright install-deps chromium'
/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && cat src/main.tsx && rg -n 'sidebar \\{|max-width: 680|useEffect|localStorage|activity-row' src/App.tsx src/styles.css"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat /etc/os-release && which apt-get && id && ls /lib && ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/orbit-libs && cd /tmp/orbit-libs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libpixman-1-0 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libharfbuzz0b libthai0 libfribidi0 libgraphite2-3 libdatrie1 libpng16-16 libwayland-server0 libavahi-client3 libavahi-common3'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'useEffect|function navigate' src/App.tsx && sed -n '345,380p' src/App.tsx && cat .gitignore && du -h public/images/*"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -lh /tmp/orbit-libs && apt-get --print-uris download libpango-1.0-0 libnspr4 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libglib2.0-0 && ls -lh *.deb 2>/dev/null'

/bin/bash -lc 'for pkg in /tmp/orbit-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$pkg" /tmp/orbit-libs/root; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg '"'not found'"
/bin/bash -lc 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/orbit-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu DEBUG=pw:browser node /tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -lh /tmp/orbit-*.png 2>/dev/null && git diff --check'

/bin/bash -lc "FONTCONFIG_PATH=/tmp/orbit-libs/root/etc/fonts LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/orbit-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu DEBUG=pw:browser node /tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs > /tmp/orbit-browser/log.txt 2>&1; rg -n 'FATAL|error while|Error initializing|not found|signal|Timeout' /tmp/orbit-browser/log.txt"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -an 'FATAL|error while|Error initializing|not found|signal|Timeout|NSS' /tmp/orbit-browser/log.txt && ls -lh public/fonts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/orbit-fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/orbit-libs/root/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/orbit-font-cache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/orbit-fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/orbit-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -lh /tmp/orbit-*.png 2>/dev/null'
/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba /tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs | sed -n '43,57p'"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import {readFile,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises';let s=await readFile('/tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs','utf8');s=s.replace(\"await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Завершённые проекты',exact:false}).click();\\nassert\", \"await page.getByRole('button',{name:'Завершённые проекты',exact:false}).click();\\nawait page.getByRole('heading',{name:'Ваши проекты',exact:true}).waitFor();\\nassert\");await writeFile('/tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs',s);
JS
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/orbit-fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/orbit-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -lh /tmp/orbit-*png 2>/dev/null && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '383,400p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '525,575p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '640,670p' src/App.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '600,625p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '500,518p' src/App.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/orbit-fonts.conf LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/orbit-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/orbit-libs/root/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu node /tmp/orbit-browser/check.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import {writeFile}from'node:fs/promises';const r=await fetch('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/main/ofl/golostext/OFL.txt');if("'!r.ok)throw Error(r.status);await writeFile('"'public/fonts/OFL.txt',await r.text());
JS
npx --yes --package prettier prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css src/main.tsx index.html
npm run build
git diff --check"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1780,1830p' src/styles.css && npm run build && git diff --check && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check'
